subject: Request: interim role conversion + backfill authorization for Model Ops lead
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: interim role conversion + backfill authorization for Model Ops lead

Hi Laura / Lauren —

Quick context: Mia Patel (Model Ops lead on Ads inference) will be out for an extended leave starting May 10 (medical). We finished her performance calibration for promotion last week; team stability is critical for the May/June model rollout.

I’m proposing a two-part temporary plan and requesting approval to move forward before the hiring freeze checkpoint next Tuesday:

1) Convert an existing contractor (Acme Retail contractor, I’ve confirmed availability) to a 6-month internal provisional appointment (non-perm) with full responsibilities as interim lead. This avoids a coverage gap for the rollout and preserves continuity for the migration to dedicated infra.
2) Open a backfill req (IC Senior Model Ops) with hiring priority "critical - 6 weeks" if we get approval. If freeze blocks new reqs, request a formal freeze exception for this headcount for the duration of the project window (May–Oct).

Attachments: org_chart_v2.pdf, MA-plan-draft.xlsx, payroll-impact-summary.csv (I attached a short cost delta and org map).

Why this is urgent: the rollout has dependencies across infra and platform; losing lead-level coordination will likely delay milestones by 6–8 weeks and increase contractor/consulting cost.

 asks:
 - Laura: sign-off to convert the contractor into a 6-month provisional internal assignment and route to People Ops for onboarding paperwork.
 - Lauren: confirm budget path and whether we can consume this off the current project PO (PRJ-5001) or whether we need a separate headcount exception code.

If helpful I can sketch the mutual action plan for the contractor -> provisional hire process; included a draft MA plan in the spreadsheet.

Thanks —
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Group Manager, Model Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: interim role conversion + backfill authorization for Model Ops lead

Jasmine —

Thanks for the clear write-up and the attachments. I reviewed the org chart and MA plan. High level: I’m supportive of the interim conversion given the promotion calibration and the technical risk to the rollout.

Before I can give formal sign-off for the freeze exception path please provide the following by EOD Monday:
- Cost delta by month (use payroll-impact-summary.csv template) and an estimate of consulting overspend avoided if we do internal conversion vs external contractor extension.
- Confirmation that the contractor has completed background checks and can be on our payroll for a provisional appointment (if not, People Ops will need to parallelize checks).
- A one-paragraph success metric for the 6-month interim (what outcomes constitute an on-track demo in Sep).

Lauren — can you confirm whether PRJ-5001 has available runway? If not, we will route to central contingency (please cc finance@redwood.ai when you reply).

If everyone aligns I will draft the freeze-exception memo and route to Legal/Finance for the Tuesday review committee.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: interim role conversion + backfill authorization for Model Ops lead

Laura / Jasmine —

PRJ-5001 has limited headroom; current forecast shows ~22% buffer through Q3 but not enough for a permanent hire. We could cover a provisional internal conversion (6 months) if we draw from contingency and reallocate some non-critical infra spend. That would need a finance acknowledgement email (I can start the request).

I’ll loop Finance now (finance@redwood.ai) and ask for a formal PO tweak approval. Karthik — can you confirm contractor background status and whether the contractor’s vendor agreement permits a provisional internal move?

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Technical Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Rebecca Moore <rebecca.moore@peopleops.org>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: interim role conversion + backfill authorization for Model Ops lead

Thanks all — People Ops can process a provisional appointment and support a freeze-exception memo. A few items to note:

1) Background & tax: we confirm the contractor (Acme Retail contractor) completed a standard background check in Jan 2027. We will need their W-9 and signed new appointment letter before payroll conversion.
2) Vendor-to-staff transition: per vendor agreement, Acme requires a 30-day notification if we transfer resource ownership; we have their contact (talent@acmeretail.com). This is standard and we can parallelize the notice with People Ops steps to avoid delay.
3) Compliance: because this role touches PII in customer telemetry, we will require a short security attestation and a scoped access review before full access is granted. Security will be cc'd into the freeze-exception memo.

Next steps I’ll take:
- Draft onboarding checklist and provisional appointment letter template and share draft link (https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-org-chart-v2) by EOD Mon.
- Create HR-4732 ticket and add the payroll-impact-summary.csv as requested.

If you want, I can prepare the freeze-exception memo draft for Laura to review; please confirm we should proceed.

Best —
Rebecca Moore
People Ops Partner
(rebecca.moore@peopleops.org)
